From: jonas_weber@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Routing question — signers and embedded signing for MSA + Order Form

Alex — great, thanks for the clarity. Proposed plan below. If that works we can create an embedded DocuSign envelope and route as you describe.

Summary of what Redwood needs before sending the embedded envelope:
- Finalized sign-by names + emails for: CFO (primary), Procurement Admin (assistant for embedded session) — we will list both and set "embedded recipient" for the admin and "in-person signer" for the CFO.
- Exact billing address + PO number to populate the Order Form (we can patch values before sending).
- Confirmation on delegation evidence: Redwood accepts an internal delegation email chain signed by the delegating signer under the following conditions: the email must come from the official corporate domain, state the delegated person and expiry, and include an approver name/title. Notarized POA is not required for typical SaaS agreements.

Routing notes / security controls:
- We'll mark the envelope to require signer authentication via email and access code (we can set an OTP to the CFO phone).
- For embedded signing, the admin will receive an authenticated link (embedded session) and can hand to the CFO locally; we will enable "view-only" audit steps for the admin.

Action items (please):
1) Alex: confirm CFO name + email and Procurement Admin name + mobile for OTP.
2) Nimbus: send delegation email (if the CFO delegates) to marissa_cole@redwood.com and cc: legal@nimbushealth.com.
3) Redwood: we'll prepare an envelope draft and a staging link for your test session before final send.

I attached a short checklist and the envelope template we plan to use. If Marissa or Rishi want to tweak the auth settings let me know.

Attachments: Embedded_Signing_Checklist.txt (text), JW_Docusign_Template_Embeddable.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
